node.statement: The exposedness-margin optimization is the finite primal LP: with d_i=p_i-p_v, choose u in R^n and t in R, maximize t, subject to 0 <= u.d_i <= 1 for every row index i and t <= u.d_f for every f in F_v. Its optimal value is exactly t*(v); it is feasible at u=0,t=0 and, because F_v is nonempty, it is bounded above by 1.
